title: Linde AG - proposed acquisition of the BOC Group plc and proffered section 87B undertaking

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commence.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Proposed announcement of ACCC findings. Decision postponed to allow for further ACCC inquiries.
Proposed announcement of ACCC findings. ACCC's indicative timeline suspended pending receipt by the ACCC of a submission from Linde Gas (Australia).
ACCC accepted an 87B undertaking and announced it will not oppose the proposed acquisition.
